1. इंग्लैंड की गौरवपूर्ण क्रांति 1688 ई. में हुई.
The Glorious Revolution of England took place in 1688 AD.

2. भारत निर्यात-आयात बैंक (Exim Bank) की स्थापना 1 जनवरी 1982 को की गई.
The Export-Import Bank of India was established on 1 January 1982.

3. जैन तीर्थंकरों में संस्कृत के श्रेष्ठ विद्वान नयचंद्र थे.
Among Jain Tirthankaras, Nayachandra was considered an eminent Sanskrit scholar.

4. ‘महाप्राण’ सूर्यकांत त्रिपाठी ‘निराला’ का उपनाम है.
‘Mahapran’ was the title of poet Suryakant Tripathi ‘Nirala’.

5. लाइकेन से प्राप्त गुलाबी उदासीन अर्क को लिटमस कहा जाता है.
The pink neutral extract obtained from lichens is called litmus.

6. किसी राज्य की विधान परिषद के 1/3 सदस्य स्थानीय निकायों द्वारा चुने जाते हैं.
One-third of the members of a State Legislative Council are elected by local bodies.

7. सबसे बड़ा विषाणु चेचक (Smallpox) का होता है.
The largest virus is the Smallpox virus.

8. हड़प्पा सभ्यता का सबसे पूर्वी स्थल आलमगीरपुर है.
The easternmost site of the Harappan civilization is Alamgirpur.

9. संस्कृत ग्रंथ ‘अष्टाध्यायी’ व्याकरण से संबंधित है.
The Sanskrit text ‘Ashtadhyayi’ is related to grammar.

10. तुंगभद्रा नदी कृष्णा नदी की सहायक नदी है.
The Tungabhadra River is a tributary of the Krishna River.

Cement is a mixture of calcium silicate and calcium aluminate.

Carbon dioxide is mainly responsible for the greenhouse effect.

Real national income is calculated using per capita income.

📌 ACQUISITION OF CITIZENSHIP.

#Citizenship

🔺️ BY DESCENT

🔸️ A person born outside India on or after January 26, 1950 but before December 10, 1992 is a citizen of India by descent, if his father was a citizen of India at the time of his birth. 

🔸️ A person born outside India on or after December 10, 1992 is considered as a citizen of India if either of his parents is a citizen of India at the time of his birth. 

🔸️ December 3, 2004 onwards, a person born outside India shall not be a citizen of India by descent, unless his birth is registered at an Indian consulate within one year of the date of birth or with the permission of the 
Central Government, after the expiry of the said period.
